3.3V digital rail: AMS1117 output powers ATmega328P and MCP4725.
I2C SDA: ATmega328P hardware TWI SDA alias (PC4 or SDA) connects to MCP4725 SDA.
I2C SCL: ATmega328P hardware TWI SCL alias (PC5 or SCL) connects to MCP4725 SCL.
Shared DAC control/bias signal reaches NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting/control node, either directly or through a resistor network.
Shared DAC control/bias signal also reaches NE5532 channel-2 non-inverting/control node for stereo shared gain/bias behavior, either directly or through a resistor network.
Left audio chain: NE5532 channel-1 output reaches PAM8403 left input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
Right audio chain: NE5532 channel-2 output reaches PAM8403 right input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
MCP4725 A0 must select I2C address: tie to GND for 0x60 or VDD for 0x61.

Critical domain isolation: USB_5V, 3.3V digital rail, GND, MT3608 switch node, MT3608 feedback node, NE5532 9V analog supply, DAC control node, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, left audio output, right audio output, and PAM8403 VREF must remain distinct. I2C isolation is anchored on MCP4725-side pins for semantic stability.
PAM8403 must not be powered from the 9V boost rail; its power pins stay on USB_5V while NE5532 VCC_P is on the boosted analog rail.
PAM8403 BTL speaker output pairs must not be shorted together or to each other.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
USB_5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V digital rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
NE5532 boosted analog supply rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
PAM8403 power rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
MT3608 EN must not float; the boost converter requires a defined enable state.
NE5532 channel-1 inverting input must not float because channel 1 is used for the left preamp path.
NE5532 channel-2 inverting input must not float because channel 2 is used for the right preamp path.
MT3608 FB must have a feedback divider for the boosted 9V analog rail.
MT3608 boost switch node must have an inductor path from USB_5V input to SW.
MT3608 SW node must have a Schottky/freewheeling rectifier path for boost output generation.
I2C SDA must not be shorted to audio or speaker output nets.
DAC control/bias output must not be shorted to PAM8403 speaker outputs.
PAM8403 left input must not be shorted to the 9V analog supply or USB_5V power rail.
PAM8403 right input must not be shorted to the 9V analog supply or USB_5V power rail.
USB_5V input rail must have input/bulk capacitor to ground.
3.3V digital rail must have decoupling capacitor to ground.
NE5532 boosted analog supply rail should have bypass capacitor to ground.
PAM8403 power rail should have local decoupling capacitor to ground.
PAM8403 VREF should have bypass capacitor to ground for low-noise operation.

passed_assertions.desc: Common ground: boost converter, LDO, MCU, DAC, NE5532 negative supply, and PAM8403 grounds share common GND with star-ground layout intent.
USB_5V input rail powers MT3608 input, AMS1117 input, and PAM8403 5V supply pins.
3.3V digital rail: AMS1117 output powers ATmega328P and MCP4725.
I2C SDA: ATmega328P hardware TWI SDA alias (PC4 or SDA) connects to MCP4725 SDA.
I2C SCL: ATmega328P hardware TWI SCL alias (PC5 or SCL) connects to MCP4725 SCL.
Shared DAC control/bias signal reaches NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting/control node, either directly or through a resistor network.
Shared DAC control/bias signal also reaches NE5532 channel-2 non-inverting/control node for stereo shared gain/bias behavior, either directly or through a resistor network.
Left audio chain: NE5532 channel-1 output reaches PAM8403 left input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
Right audio chain: NE5532 channel-2 output reaches PAM8403 right input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
MCP4725 A0 must select I2C address: tie to GND for 0x60 or VDD for 0x61.

Critical domain isolation: USB_5V, 3.3V digital rail, GND, MT3608 switch node, MT3608 feedback node, NE5532 9V analog supply, DAC control node, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, left audio output, right audio output, and PAM8403 VREF must remain distinct. I2C isolation is anchored on MCP4725-side pins for semantic stability.
PAM8403 must not be powered from the 9V boost rail; its power pins stay on USB_5V while NE5532 VCC_P is on the boosted analog rail.
PAM8403 BTL speaker output pairs must not be shorted together or to each other.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
USB_5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V digital rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
NE5532 boosted analog supply rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
PAM8403 power rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
MT3608 EN must not float; the boost converter requires a defined enable state.
NE5532 channel-1 inverting input must not float because channel 1 is used for the left preamp path.
NE5532 channel-2 inverting input must not float because channel 2 is used for the right preamp path.
MT3608 FB must have a feedback divider for the boosted 9V analog rail.
MT3608 boost switch node must have an inductor path from USB_5V input to SW.
I2C SDA requires pull-up resistor to the 3.3V digital rail. Anchored on MCP4725 SDA to target the bus itself.
I2C SCL requires pull-up resistor to the 3.3V digital rail. Anchored on MCP4725 SCL to target the bus itself.
I2C SDA must not be shorted to audio or speaker output nets.
DAC control/bias output must not be shorted to PAM8403 speaker outputs.
PAM8403 left input must not be shorted to the 9V analog supply or USB_5V power rail.
PAM8403 right input must not be shorted to the 9V analog supply or USB_5V power rail.
USB_5V input rail must have input/bulk capacitor to ground.
3.3V digital rail must have decoupling capacitor to ground.
NE5532 boosted analog supply rail should have bypass capacitor to ground.
PAM8403 power rail should have local decoupling capacitor to ground.
PAM8403 VREF should have bypass capacitor to ground for low-noise operation.

passed_assertions.desc: GND unification: all ground pins across 4 ICs share one common ground net.
3.3V domain unification: regulator output, MCU core/analog/battery supply, sensor supply+IO, and display supply share one power net. CSB excluded (handled separately by ANY-002).

Critical net isolation: GND, VCC_3V3, VIN, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, OSC_IN, OSC_OUT, and NRST must all reside on mutually distinct nets. Uses fixed peripheral-side bus pins so the check is invariant to MCU I2C pin mapping.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
3.3V rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
I2C bus legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal SDA/SCL pair of STM32F103 hardware I2C routing. This avoids illegal mixed mappings such as PB7 for SDA with PB8 for SCL.
BOOT0 must not be tied to VDD; doing so forces bootloader mode instead of normal flash boot.
BOOT0 grounding policy: accept either direct tie to GND or pull-down resistor to GND.
BME280 CSB must select I2C mode: either direct tie to VDD or external pull-up resistor to power.
NRST requires RC reset topology: pull-up resistor to power plus filter capacitor to ground.
HSE crystal on OSC_IN/OSC_OUT with load capacitors to ground on each side.
I2C SDA line requires external pull-up resistor to power. Anchored on the fixed peripheral-side SDA pin so the assertion is invariant to MCU pin mapping.
I2C SCL line requires external pull-up resistor to power. Anchored on the fixed peripheral-side SCL pin so the assertion is invariant to MCU pin mapping.
LDO input rail (VIN) must have bypass capacitor to ground.
3.3V domain must have decoupling capacitor to ground. One T01 covers the unified rail per dedup rule.

passed_assertions.desc: Common ground: boost converter, LDO, MCU, DAC, NE5532 negative supply, and PAM8403 grounds share common GND with star-ground layout intent.
USB_5V input rail powers MT3608 input, AMS1117 input, and PAM8403 5V supply pins.
3.3V digital rail: AMS1117 output powers ATmega328P and MCP4725.
I2C SDA: ATmega328P hardware TWI SDA alias (PC4 or SDA) connects to MCP4725 SDA.
I2C SCL: ATmega328P hardware TWI SCL alias (PC5 or SCL) connects to MCP4725 SCL.
Shared DAC control/bias signal reaches NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting/control node, either directly or through a resistor network.
Shared DAC control/bias signal also reaches NE5532 channel-2 non-inverting/control node for stereo shared gain/bias behavior, either directly or through a resistor network.
Left audio chain: NE5532 channel-1 output reaches PAM8403 left input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
Right audio chain: NE5532 channel-2 output reaches PAM8403 right input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
MCP4725 A0 must select I2C address: tie to GND for 0x60 or VDD for 0x61.

Critical domain isolation: USB_5V, 3.3V digital rail, GND, MT3608 switch node, MT3608 feedback node, NE5532 9V analog supply, DAC control node, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, left audio output, right audio output, and PAM8403 VREF must remain distinct. I2C isolation is anchored on MCP4725-side pins for semantic stability.
PAM8403 must not be powered from the 9V boost rail; its power pins stay on USB_5V while NE5532 VCC_P is on the boosted analog rail.
PAM8403 BTL speaker output pairs must not be shorted together or to each other.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
USB_5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V digital rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
NE5532 boosted analog supply rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
PAM8403 power rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
MT3608 EN must not float; the boost converter requires a defined enable state.
NE5532 channel-1 inverting input must not float because channel 1 is used for the left preamp path.
NE5532 channel-2 inverting input must not float because channel 2 is used for the right preamp path.
MT3608 FB must have a feedback divider for the boosted 9V analog rail.
MT3608 boost switch node must have an inductor path from USB_5V input to SW.
MT3608 SW node must have a Schottky/freewheeling rectifier path for boost output generation.
I2C SDA requires pull-up resistor to the 3.3V digital rail. Anchored on MCP4725 SDA to target the bus itself.
I2C SCL requires pull-up resistor to the 3.3V digital rail. Anchored on MCP4725 SCL to target the bus itself.
I2C SDA must not be shorted to audio or speaker output nets.
DAC control/bias output must not be shorted to PAM8403 speaker outputs.
PAM8403 left input must not be shorted to the 9V analog supply or USB_5V power rail.

passed_assertions.desc: Common ground: power regulators, STM32 grounds/reference-negative, IMU ground, barometer grounds, and flash ground share one common GND with star-ground layout intent.
5V input rail feeds both the TPS54331 digital buck input and the ME6211 analog/sensor LDO input.
3.3V digital rail powers STM32F427 digital VDD pins, USB supply pin, backup domain, and W25Q128JV flash VCC.

Core analog/sensor rail: ME6211 output powers the motion/barometer sensor supplies. This captures the separate sensor rail requirement without over-constraining STM32 analog-domain implementation details.
MPU-6050 I2C legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal STM32F427 hardware I2C SDA/SCL pair to the IMU. This forbids illegal mixed mappings such as PB7 for SDA together with PB8 for SCL.
MPU-6050 is configured for I2C mode by tying CS to its supply rail.
BMP280 has an independent chip-select from one legal STM32F427 control pin.
W25Q128JV flash has an independent chip-select from one legal STM32F427 control pin.
MPU-6050 AD0 must select a valid I2C address: GND for 0x68 or VDD for 0x69.
STM32F427 analog supply/reference-positive may either join the dedicated analog/sensor rail or remain on the digital 3.3V rail, but VDDA and VREF_P must be implemented consistently together.
W25Q128JV WP must be held inactive for normal Standard SPI operation: either directly tied high or pulled up to power.
W25Q128JV HOLD must be held inactive for normal Standard SPI operation: either directly tied high or pulled up to power.
Digital 3.3V and analog/sensor 3.3V rails are separate rails and must not be shorted.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V digital rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V analog/sensor rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
TPS54331 EN must not float; the digital buck regulator requires a defined enable state.
TPS54331 feedback divider on VSENSE sets the digital 3.3V buck output.
TPS54331 switch node PH must reach the 3.3V digital output rail through an inductor.
TPS54331 switch node must have a freewheeling diode path.
I2C SDA requires pull-up resistor to a valid 3.3V rail. Anchored on the MPU-6050 SDA pin so the assertion is invariant to STM32 I2C pin selection.
I2C SCL requires pull-up resistor to a valid 3.3V rail. Anchored on the MPU-6050 SCL pin so the assertion is invariant to STM32 I2C pin selection.
5V input rail must have input bypass capacitor to ground.
3.3V digital rail must have output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
3.3V analog/sensor rail must have output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
MPU-6050 REGOUT requires capacitor to ground.
MPU-6050 CPOUT requires charge-pump capacitor to ground.
BMP280 VDD requires local decoupling capacitor to ground.
W25Q128JV VCC requires local decoupling capacitor to ground.
MPU-6050 I2C-mode CS must not be tied to SPI chip-select nets.

Critical rail and low-voltage control/interface nets must remain distinct: motor rail, 5V rail, 3.3V rail, GND, TPS54331 switch node, TPS54331 feedback node, shared TMC2209 UART bus, both channels' STEP/DIR/ENN nets, and flash SPI/CS nets.
Common ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
Motor input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
5V buck output rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
3.3V logic rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
TPS54331 feedback divider on VSENSE sets the 5V buck output.
TPS54331 switch node PH must reach the 5V rail through an inductor.
TPS54331 switch node must have a freewheeling diode path.
Motor input rail must have bulk/input capacitor to ground.
5V rail must have output/decoupling capacitor to ground.
3.3V logic rail must have decoupling capacitor to ground.
TMC2209 channel A motor supply requires local bulk capacitor to ground.
TMC2209 channel B motor supply requires local bulk capacitor to ground.
TMC2209 channel A internal 5VOUT requires local capacitor to ground.
TMC2209 channel B internal 5VOUT requires local capacitor to ground.
W25Q64JV VCC requires local decoupling capacitor to ground.
TMC2209 channel A charge pump requires capacitor path between CPO and CPI.
TMC2209 channel B charge pump requires capacitor path between CPO and CPI.
TMC2209 channel A VCP requires capacitor path to motor supply VS.
TMC2209 channel B VCP requires capacitor path to motor supply VS.
W25Q64JV WP must be held inactive for normal Standard SPI operation: either directly tied high or pulled up to power.
W25Q64JV HOLD must be held inactive for normal Standard SPI operation: either directly tied high or pulled up to power.

5V LED power domain: LDO input (VIN), MAX7219 VIN, and 74HC595 VCC share one power net.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
3.3V rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
5V rail must carry Power electrical attribute.

SPI serial-data-plus-clock legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal STM32F103 SPI1 routing bundle for MOSI and SCK, either default pins or remapped pins. This forbids illegal mixed mappings such as PA7 for MOSI together with PB3 for SCK.
Daisy-chain stage 2: MAX7219 DOUT cascades to 74HC595 SER.
MAX7219 latch: MCU PA4 connects to MAX7219 LOAD.
Anti-bypass (star topology prevention): 74HC595 SER must not connect directly to any STM32 MOSI candidate pin. Data must flow through MAX7219 DOUT in daisy-chain.
BOOT0 must not be tied to VDD; forces bootloader mode.
BOOT0 grounding policy: direct tie to GND or pull-down resistor to GND.
74HC595 OE (active-low output enable) tied to GND: outputs always enabled.
74HC595 SRCLR (active-low shift register clear) tied to VCC: never cleared.
MAX7219 ISET: programming resistor to 5V sets LED segment current. T06 verifies resistor-to-power path exists.
STM32 NRST requires RC reset topology: pull-up resistor to power plus filter capacitor to ground.
STM32 HSE 8MHz crystal on OSC_IN/OSC_OUT with load capacitors to ground.
3.3V MCU domain must have decoupling capacitor to ground.
5V LED domain must have decoupling capacitor to ground. One T01 covers the unified 5V rail.

3.3V digital rail: AMS1117 output powers ATmega328P and MCP4725.
I2C SDA: ATmega328P hardware TWI SDA alias (PC4 or SDA) connects to MCP4725 SDA.
I2C SCL: ATmega328P hardware TWI SCL alias (PC5 or SCL) connects to MCP4725 SCL.
Shared DAC control/bias signal reaches NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting/control node, either directly or through a resistor network.
Shared DAC control/bias signal also reaches NE5532 channel-2 non-inverting/control node for stereo shared gain/bias behavior, either directly or through a resistor network.
Left audio chain: NE5532 channel-1 output reaches PAM8403 left input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
Right audio chain: NE5532 channel-2 output reaches PAM8403 right input, either directly or through an AC-coupling capacitor.
MCP4725 A0 must select I2C address: tie to GND for 0x60 or VDD for 0x61.

Critical domain isolation: USB_5V, 3.3V digital rail, GND, MT3608 switch node, MT3608 feedback node, NE5532 9V analog supply, DAC control node, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, left audio output, right audio output, and PAM8403 VREF must remain distinct. I2C isolation is anchored on MCP4725-side pins for semantic stability.
PAM8403 must not be powered from the 9V boost rail; its power pins stay on USB_5V while NE5532 VCC_P is on the boosted analog rail.

NE5532 channel-2 inverting input must not float because channel 2 is used for the right preamp path.
MT3608 FB must have a feedback divider for the boosted 9V analog rail.

Motor direction control AIN2: one legal STM32F103 control GPIO connects to TB6612 AIN2.

Current feedback: INA128 output connects to one legal STM32F103 ADC-capable input.

passed_assertions.desc: Non-isolated ground backbone: U1 ground and STM32 grounds share common GND.
Isolated ground backbone: U2 ground, ADS1118 ground, and REF5050 ground share ISO_GND.
Non-isolated 3.3V backbone: U1 output powers STM32 core/analog supplies.
Isolated 3.3V backbone: U2 output powers ADS1118.
Forward isolated SPI pair is implemented through ISO7721 U4 with a legal STM32F103 SPI SCK/MOSI bundle; A/B channel order may be swapped but the isolated-side outputs must reach ADS1118 SCLK and DIN.
Reverse isolated SPI return uses one U5 channel to bring ADS1118 DOUT back to a legal STM32F103 SPI MISO pin; A/B channel selection may be swapped.
